title: On the isoperimetric profile in infinite dimensional pro-Lie groups
summary: Let $K$ be a nontrivial compact connected Lie group with a bi-invariant Riemannian metric. On the compact pro-Lie group $K^{\N}$ we define a weighted variation by summing the distributional variations in its Lie group coordinates. We prove that all sublevel sets with bounded $L^1$-norm and weighted variation are compact in $L^1$ if and only if the coordinate weights tend to infinity.
